findings.note: The clause opens the scholarship to 'OBCs, EBCs and DNTs, as notified', and the guideline defines EBC/DNT students as those 'not covered under SC, ST or OBC' (i.e. general-category students holding an EBC or DNT certificate). The logic social_category == 'obc' with hard + confirmed returns a definite NOT_ELIGIBLE for an EBC or DNT student (general or EWS), which contradicts both the clause and the rule's own text ('EBC and DNT students can also apply: check with the office').
findings.suggestion: Split the rule: (a) a confirmed hard rule {"!":[{"in":[{"var":"social_category"},["sc","st"]]}]} (SC/ST have their own schemes), and (b) category_obc kept as {"==":[{"var":"social_category"},"obc"]} but with confidence 'uncertain', so general/EWS students get 'check with the office' (EBC/DNT certificate) instead of NOT_ELIGIBLE. Alternatively propose an is_ebc_or_dnt field. Update the 'general category' fixture to expect NEED_MORE_INFO.
